manifest.name: Watch History
manifest.description: Everything you've watched, as filterable rows: your Stremio history plus anything you mark or import as watched. Made alongside Mycelium.

manifest.name: Halloween After Dark
manifest.description: HAD = Halloween After Dark. Automatically updated. 8962 curated movies, 628 spooky shows and 247 Halloween episodes. Slashers, cozy favorites, haunted TV, hidden gems and 31 Nights of Halloween. Choose collections and filter your mood. Playback uses your installed stream add-ons. Created by Jason Minnie.

manifest.name: TMDB Catalog: Year, Country & Rating
manifest.description: ⚙️ Setup required: open https://tmdb-year-catalog-addon.vercel.app/configure, add your free TMDB key and install from there. Browse top movies and series by country of origin, year/decade and TMDB rating, with smart search ("2023 8+", "dune 2024"). Returns IMDb IDs compatible with all stream addons. Works in Stremio, Nuvio and Alder.

manifest.name: Torrent Catalogs
manifest.description: Provides catalogs for movies/series/anime based on top seeded torrents. Requires Kitsu addon for anime.

torrentio.name: Torrentio
torrentio.description: Provides torrent streams from scraped torrent providers. Currently supports YTS(+), EZTV(+), RARBG(+), 1337x(+), EXT(+), ThePirateBay(+), KickassTorrents(+), TorrentGalaxy(+), UIndex(+), Knaben(+), MagnetDL(+), HorribleSubs(+), NyaaSi(+), AnimeTosho(+), TokyoTosho(+), AniDex(+), nekoBT(+), Rutor(+), Rutracker(+), Comando(+), BluDV(+), MicoLeaoDublado(+), Torrent9(+), ilCorSaRoNeRo(+), MejorTorrent(+), Wolfmax4k(+), Cinecalidad(+), BestTorrents(+). To configure providers, RealDebrid/Premiumize/AllDebrid/DebridLink/EasyDebrid/Offcloud/TorBox/Put.io/HighWay support and other settings visit https://torrentio.strem.fun
